contrasts.line: Faint is almost no volume. Muffled means something is covering or blocking the sound.
Faint is barely there. Piercing is strong, high, and painful.
Faint is tiny in volume. Booming is big, low, and room-shaking.
Faint is almost no volume. Squeaky is small and peepy, not necessarily weak.
Muffled is covered or blocked. Faint is simply very weak.
Muffled sounds wrapped up. Piercing sounds biting and painful.
Muffled is dulled by a cover. Booming is big, low, and shaking.
Muffled is blocked and dull. Squeaky is tiny, peepy, and chirpy.
Piercing is biting and painful. Faint is barely there.
Piercing cuts through. Muffled is dulled by something in the way.
Piercing is high and painful. Booming is low, huge, and shaking.
Piercing feels painfully sharp. Squeaky is small, peepy, and often funny.
Booming is big, low, and shaking. Faint is almost no volume.
Booming rolls out strongly. Muffled is dulled by a cover or block.
Booming is low and huge. Piercing is high, biting, and painful.
Booming is big and low. Squeaky is small, peepy, and light.
Squeaky is small and peepy. Faint is simply very weak.
Squeaky is chirpy and tiny. Muffled is covered, blocked, and dull.
Squeaky is small and peepy. Piercing is painfully sharp.
Squeaky is tiny and chirpy. Booming is big, low, and shaking.
